# AdaptiveSTDP

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spike-timing-dependent plasticity rule with dynamically adjusted learning rates or time constants, tailored for graph-structured anomaly detection tasks. Enables neuromorphic systems to adapt to non-stationary graph data distributions, improving detection accuracy without external supervision.
